segments.title: Post-China Return & Studio Move Announcement
segments.notes: Case Blackwell returns from China trip, announces move to new studio tomorrow, discusses Chinese wage growth and cost of living; Pepito delivers cold open sign-on.

segments.title: Hype Train Derails Into Eminem Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train acknowledges subscribers then abandons registry for high-tempo Eminem-style rap over Groundhog Day instrumental, claiming Chinese high-speed rail origins.

segments.title: Trump Cabinet Picks & Project 2025 Debate
segments.notes: Munch (as 'Chad') and Crum clash over Trump's Project 2025-aligned cabinet selections including Rubio, Hegseth, Bondi, RFK Jr., and Linda McMahon; Crum reveals balding history.

segments.title: JD Vance Interview on Project 2025
segments.notes: JD Vance joins desk to discuss Project 2025 with Crum; Vance claims he's hiding from cameras, Crum admits Democratic Party has no beliefs during restructuring phase.

segments.title: Etiquette, Cravats, Alligator Grilling & Body Horror Tutorials
segments.notes: Jeb hosts from workshop while Case attends work meeting; watches Hazely Lopez etiquette videos, cravat tying, Fourth of July Heritage Loaf, rockstar eyeliner, condom nose-inflation, eyeball popping, and male breast exam tutorials; Jeb's dead father interjects from wooden board.

segments.title: Garve Reviews 1987 Marvel Parade & Cat Videos
segments.notes: Garve hosts with tablet-as-phone; watches 1987 Marvel Comics parade float footage, cat compilation, skull-rocking video, and Billy Bob Thornton 'Landman' oil rant clips.

segments.title: Crumb Attempts Hostile Takeover of Park Broadcast
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein broadcasts from park bushes; Crum tries to seize hosting duties, feuds with park regular Donnie Whiskers over bush-peeing allegations; guinea pig appears.

segments.title: Sign-Off: Patreon Plans & Bruce Green Raid
segments.notes: Case wraps broadcast, announces Call of Cas Patreon show tonight at 6pm, December 4 event with Will Neff/Casem/Bruce Green, raids Bruce Green channel.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors post-China return broadcast while preparing for imminent studio move and juggling Amazon job wrap-up.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Delivers cold open sign-on as executive producer and dog.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Derails subscriber thank-yous into Eminem-style freestyle rap over Groundhog Day beat.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Serves as Democratic counterweight to Munch, reveals balding origin story and admits party has no beliefs during restructuring.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Returns as 'nice guy Chad' to spar with Crum over Trump cabinet picks and Project 2025.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Infiltrates broadcast from alleged China location, claims dead father trapped in wood during Jeb segment.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosts How To with Jeb while Case attends work meeting, watches etiquette, cravat, cooking, and body horror tutorials.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host. Interjects from wooden board to forbid Jeb's parasocial fixation on Hazely Lopez.

characters.name: Garve
characters.notes: Hosts Amongst the Web with tablet-as-phone, reacts to 1987 Marvel parade float and cat videos.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Broadcasts from park bushes, fends off Crum's host takeover attempt and interviews park denizens including Donnie Whiskers.

characters.name: Donnie Whiskers
characters.notes: park denizen. Park regular accuses Trip of bush-peeing feud instigated by Crumb.

storylines.beat: Case mentions 'eight hour crumb stream soon' at 01:06:39, referencing pending community-pledge tournament execution.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from China to a chaotic pre-move broadcast featuring a Hype Train Eminem freestyle, a Munch & Crum debate over Trump's Project 2025 cabinet that devolves into Crum admitting the Democratic Party has no beliefs, and a JD Vance interview where the VP-elect claims he's hiding from cameras. The show fractures further when Case leaves for a work meeting, leaving Jeb to host a parade of body-horror tutorials while his dead father heckles from a wooden board. Garve's Amongst the Web and Trip's park broadcast — interrupted by Crum's hostile takeover attempt — round out the night before Case signs off to raid Bruce Green.
